target_customer: Dental practices that lose revenue from overdue recalls, lapsed patients and unscheduled treatment plans
problem: Practices have patient lists with missed revenue but front desks lack time to call them, so appointments go unbooked.
business_model: Monthly subscription per practice, Hygiene Recall listed at 970 USD per month on the company site
product_category: AI outbound calling and texting for dental recall

founders.name: Max Bohun
founders.background_notes: A profile site describes him as a Cornell founder; YC page lists no education.

competitors.name: Weave
competitors.what: Dental communications suite with text based recall and reminders

competitors.name: Solutionreach and NexHealth
competitors.what: Patient communication and recall automation tools

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrations with practice management systems (Dentrix, Open Dental, Eaglesoft) and voice AI calling use available models and APIs; the hard parts are integrations and compliance.

defensibility.rationale: Deep integration with practice systems adds some lock in, but voice and text agents are easy for others to build.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents offered text based recall; many AI recall vendors appeared by 2026 per vendor blogs.

market_need_then: Vendor guides cite recall reactivation as a large revenue gap for practices; the company reports over 30k USD per month incremental revenue for one Miami practice (self reported).

branding.domain_note: Uses 10xdental.com; the team also kept email on the gradewiz.tech domain per a profile site.

identity.voice_and_tone: ROI focused, claims 5.3 times more overdue patients booked than a human front desk

rebrands.why: Founders moved from classroom grading to dental recall within the same YC cycle, per a profile site

branding.community_and_virality: None found beyond profile pages and a post claiming 1M USD ARR with no outbound sales.

brand_strength.rationale: 10x is a common startup word and the name says nothing about dental. The company sits under the GradeWiz legal brand per its footer.

pivots.from: GradeWiz, an AI teaching assistant for grading
pivots.to: AI sales team for dental practices
pivots.why: Profile sites say GradeWiz was wound down; no official notice found

outcome_analysis: 10x pivoted from GradeWiz into dental recall and, per founder posts reported by an aggregator, reached seven figure ARR with no outbound sales. The company is active and hiring. Revenue claims are self reported, and funding beyond YC is unknown, so the pivot is the main supported factor.
notes: Unverified: one directory lists about 500K USD raised from Y Combinator, single aggregator, not recorded as a round. ARR claim (1M USD) is from arr.club and a founder post, unverified. Competitor sources are 2026 vendor blogs; the competitor list is weakly dated to 2025.
